summary: Extract zero or more commitment candidate signals from arbitrary text.

text.description: Arbitrary source text to scan for commitment signals.

context.description: Optional background context (e.g. conversation metadata, speaker roles) that may help the model interpret the text.

candidates.description: Extracted commitment candidates, ordered by descending confidence.

description.description: Concise, self-contained description of the commitment.

importance.description: Estimated importance on a 1–3 scale; null if indeterminate.

effort_provided.description: Estimated effort on a 1–3 scale; null if indeterminate.

due_by.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime of the deadline; null if not stated.

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone name associated with the deadline; null if not stated.

reasoning.description: One-sentence explanation of why this text signals a commitment.
